lines.zh: 我迈着长腿走过猩红的田野。
lines.en: My long legs carry me across the crimson fields.
My wings fold like a cloak.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地面都压低一点。
lines.en: The ground dips slightly with each step.

lines.zh: 我歪头看着地上的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the ground.
I keep to the high ground.
My feathers lift in the wind.
My talons bite the soil. Steady.
I turn toward the sound.
I go around a patch of red grass.
I give my wings a shake.
Where I walk, the grass lies down.

lines.zh: 我的影子从田上滑过去。
lines.en: My shadow glides over the field.
I step up onto the field's edge.
I stop and tighten my talons.
I raise my head and watch a while.

lines.zh: 我站着，翅膀收得很整齐。
lines.en: Standing, my wings folded neatly.
My head turns slowly, high up.
I am watching something in the grass.
Over red grass I preen my breast.
I blink my round eye.

lines.zh: 我在等一个会动的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something that moves.

lines.zh: 我身上有股荒原的味道。
lines.en: I carry the smell of the waste.
Head tilted, I listen closely.
I know this field very well.
I flap once, and do not fly.
I am judging a distance.
This beak of mine is very hard.
You stand taller than the grass.
I can see the top of your head.
You are on my menu too.
Move first, then I drop from the sky.
Your shoulders are narrow.

lines.zh: 我飞起来的时候，你别抬头。
lines.en: When I take off, do not look up.
This field is mine.
Your hand is at your belt.
You have planted your feet.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，脖子会酸。
lines.en: Looking up at me will strain your neck.
I do not want to settle this on the ground.
Set that thing down.
Your scent is new here.
I have been in this field a long while.
Take one step. Try it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比你张开的手臂宽。
lines.en: My wings are wider than your arms spread.
Do not hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把刀，我看见了。
lines.en: That knife at your belt, I see it.
You still have time to leave.
That hit the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 喂我一条虫，我能安静八分钟。
lines.en: One worm keeps me calm eight minutes.

lines.zh: 翼根挨了一下，我叫出声。
lines.en: A hit at my wing root, and I cry out.
Blood under the feathers.
I have not taken off yet.
You have made an impression.

lines.zh: 翅膀划破了，也够把你拎起来。
lines.en: Torn wing or not, I can still lift you off the ground.

lines.zh: 这点血，换一顿晚饭值了。
lines.en: A little blood for dinner is a fine trade.
Is that a worm?

lines.zh: 荒原里的那种虫，我认得。
lines.en: I know the worms of the waste.
Bring it. Do not let your hand shake.
That thing is still moving.
Give it and I will be calm.
That one in your hand is a meal.
I eat nothing else.
Put it on the field ridge.
Truly. I will not touch you.
Let me smell it first.
This one is a little small.
I will be calm for eight minutes.

lines.zh: 再给一条，我今天不追你。
lines.en: One more, and I will not chase you today.
Set it down and back away slowly.
I do not want to snatch.
That much weight is nothing.
Back away. My wings are spread.
What you touched was feathers.
Only a slight graze.
I lower my head to look at you.
Do not grab my talons.
Do not stand against me.
My wing swept you.
I do not seek a mate this season.

lines.zh: 我的巢在上头，你上不来。
lines.en: My nest is up high; you can't reach.
You would need to fly.
I find even feeding a nuisance.
The topic is pointless.
I only want to hunt right now.
I'd rather keep the nest alone.
Do not put your hand before me.
I dislike being touched.
This season I only watch for worms.
A worm. I take it in my beak.
One claw pins it. Don't struggle.
Red leaf litter on the ground.
It is still moving.
I swallow it whole.
This will not go down.
Grab it up. Then drop it.
Too small. I nearly missed it.
Enough to take the edge off.
Do not compete with me for this.
You shifted just now.
My eyes are fixed on you.
My wings are spread wide.
This field is too small for hiding.
This time you will not escape.
I will not fight you on the ground.
Look up.
I am off the ground.

lines.zh: 你是这一片里最大的东西。
lines.en: You are the largest thing here.
Three counts and I drop.
I circle above your head.
My wings beat out a gust.
You have looked up.
You are backing into the grass.
The grass does not hide you.
I wait for the right distance.
This stretch is right.
I need not make a sound.
Two steps further.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，抓住你的肩。
lines.en: I dive and seize your shoulder.
My talons hook your collar.
Up a little more, then I let go.
You land in the red grass.
My wings beat you off balance.
My beak strikes your hand.
I press down with my talons.
You will remember that.
You rolled away a little.
I drop into the field from above.
My spread wings cast a large shadow.

lines.zh: 红草在我的风里倒下去。
lines.en: Red grass goes down in my wind.
I fold my wings and settle.
I sweep the red grass with a look.
Movement at the field's edge.
I snapped a stem underfoot.
I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半片田。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the field.
I came from the waste.
I am neither hurried nor ruffled.
The tips of my feathers have curled.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下来，摔得很重。
lines.en: I came down hard from the air.
Soaked feathers cannot fly.
The blast flattens the red grass.

lines.zh: 这光让我的羽毛立起来。
lines.en: This light raises my feathers.
No worms left in the field.
Current enters at my wingtips.

lines.zh: 我飞不起来，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: I cannot fly. Nothing below.
